notes.subject: אחרית
notes.rationale: אחרית repeats from v.37 — same word for the end of the man of peace and of the wicked, contrast lost somewhat in Tok Pisin but kept with 'pinis'

notes.subject: ol man i brukim lo
notes.rationale: פושעים is 'those who break away (from just authority)'; Tok Pisin renders the picture of breaking

translation: Na ol man i brukim lo, ol i lus olgeta wantaim; pinis bilong ol man nogut — ol i katim em i go ausait.

tokens.gloss: Na ol man i brukim lo
ol i katim em i go ausait
